results.evidence: Section 18.3: "Distributor shall not assign or transfer this Agreement, or any of its rights or obligations under it, whether voluntarily, by operation of law, by merger or change of control, or otherwise, without the prior written consent of Supplier. Any purported assignment or transfer in breach of this Section 18.3 is void. This Agreement binds and benefits the Parties and their respective successors and permitted assigns."

Section 7.2: "During the Term and for twenty-four (24) months after its expiry or termination, Distributor shall not, directly or indirectly, whether on its own account or through any Affiliate or third party, market, promote, sell, resell, distribute, install or support any Competing Product anywhere in the United States." Section 1.1 defines "Competing Product" as "any product, system, device, software or service, other than the Products, that is used in or in connection with pupil transportation." Section 1.3: "The Order Form controls only as to pricing and quantities."

DPA Section 9: "Each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or in connection with this Addendum, including liability for any Personal Data Breach, is subject to the limitations of liability in Section 12 of the Agreement. The amount stated in Section 12.2 of the Agreement is the maximum aggregate liability of each Party under this Addendum."

Section 3.2: "Upon expiry of the Initial Term, this Agreement shall automatically renew for successive Renewal Terms of the length stated in the Order Form. Either Party may elect not to renew this Agreement by giving written notice of non-renewal to the other Party during the period beginning ninety (90) days before and ending sixty (60) days before the expiry of the Initial Term or the then-current Renewal Term, as applicable. Any notice of non-renewal given outside that period shall be ineffective, and this Agreement shall renew in accordance with this Section 3.2." Order Form 5.1–5.2: "The Initial Term is three (3) years from the Distribution Agreement Effective Date." / "Each Renewal Term is five (5) years."
